causal_effect_predicates.ABL_LOCAL_SHIFT_DELETE: semantic posterior and either query or unqueried prediction changes on at least one D2 case
causal_effect_predicates.ABL_NO_UPDATE: complete member-and-forward fails and at least one primary canonical member same-history or common-forward benefit is reduced by >=4375/1000000
causal_effect_predicates.ABL_POSTQUERY_SOURCE_DELETE: complete member-and-forward fails and at least one primary canonical member same-history benefit is reduced by >=4375/1000000
causal_effect_predicates.ABL_QUERY_OUTCOME_MASK: complete member-and-forward fails and at least one primary canonical member same-history or common-forward benefit is reduced by >=4375/1000000
causal_effect_predicates.ABL_SHAM_ROTATION: both registered sham EVSI arms fail complete member-and-forward

records.definition: Delete source and local families and invoke canonical PUBLIC_L1_RISK_DP; semantic state, query, and prediction bytes must be identical; no duplicate callable.
Use I_TRANSFER_NO_LOCAL with primitive mapping weight 1+20*c_B; normalization cancels.
Rows remain receipts and observed-value copies but never condition the unqueried inference or acquisition distribution.
For each conservative candidate retain its inference and decision and replace acquisition with A_PASSIVE.
Choose under transfer H1, serialize and copy the H2 observed token, but retain H1 posterior for all unqueried predictions.
Choose under transfer H1, then use exact scratch posterior on the identical H2 and D_SCRATCH_L1 before prediction.
Replace every source tuple (m0,m1,m2,m3,m4) with (m1,m2,m3,m4,m0) before all counts.
Unique support has equal mass and local shift is regenerated from unique support with weight k+120*c_U+12*c_LU.
Enumerate all 6!/product(multiplicity factorial) unique entry orders; canonical semantic state, query, and prediction bytes are invariant.
records.scope: every unique bank; every registered trajectory arm

records.definition: Separately run all 120 token permutations, relabel source/target columns and initial token, inverse-map outputs, and require semantic equality.
Separately run all 120 prototype permutations, relabel prototype indices and table rows together, inverse-map receipts, and require semantic equality.
Independent EIG and maximum-outcome-entropy callables match every integer score, minimizer set, and lexical choice.
Run all three registered H1-only arms; own-unqueried endpoint has four tokens and 16 components.

acquisition.A_ALL_QUERY_ORACLE: verifier-only four-query enumeration; no witness enters arm or verdict

A_EIG.equivalence: deterministic-outcome mutual information equals outcome entropy
A_EIG.objective: minimize product over positive N_qy of N_qy**N_qy where N_qy=sum W_H1(pi)*1[pi[q]=y]

acquisition.A_FIXED: named fixed eligible token in base runs

A_L1_EVSI.objective: minimize R(q)=sum_y sum_{pi:W_H1(pi)>0,pi[q]=y} W_H1(pi)*sum_{r not in {initial,q}} L1(a_qy[r],P[pi[r]])
A_L1_EVSI.outcome_weight: exact posterior predictive primitive integer mass

acquisition.A_MAX_OUTCOME_ENTROPY: independent callable; must reproduce every A_EIG score, minimizer set, and choice
acquisition.A_UNIFORM_MIXTURE: exact 1/4 expectation over four fixed-query branches; aggregate only and cannot rescue trajectory gate
acquisition.tie_policy_enumeration: for each bank/arm enumerate Cartesian choices of one exact minimizer per nonempty H1 leaf; pairwise gates enumerate product policies; max 4^5 per arm/bank

amortization_ceiling_control.builder: separate callable enumerates frozen public domain and invokes canonical primary once per canonical (bank,H1) query state and (bank,H2) prediction state
amortization_ceiling_control.interpretation: match is tautological and expected; it blocks learned-representation and non-memorization claims but does not block an algorithmic-reference verdict
amortization_ceiling_control.lookup_input: same exact closed public fields; no target, scorer, stratum, distance, or future key
amortization_ceiling_control.required_result: byte-match primary on every in-suite public state; mismatch is ACTIVE_TRANSFER_INSTRUMENT_INVALID

bank_suite.alias_rule: compute once; retain and gate every role label
bank_suite.canonical_bank_bytes: compact JSON of six mapping arrays sorted lexicographically with duplicates retained

hash_bank.digest: SHA256(UTF8(task_id + U+001F + "HASH_BANK" + U+001F + decimal(index) + U+001F + compact_mapping_json))

multiplicity_bank.digest: SHA256(UTF8(task_id + U+001F + "MULTIPLICITY" + U+001F + compact_partition_json + U+001F + compact_mapping_json))

property_predicates.B_BALANCED_MARGINAL: exists y with at least two distinct compatible source mappings, exactly equal label-sensitive four conditional source-entry marginal vectors, and at least two unequal label-sensitive ordered 25-cell joint vectors; EIG tie gate is I_CONSISTENCY, not I_TRANSFER
property_predicates.B_COLLISION: for every legal policy exists nonempty G_y and distinct m,m_prime with same selected outcome plus common-unqueried token r with positive prototype L1 distance
property_predicates.B_DECOY: exists legal H1 where I_TRANSFER plus midpoint D_L1_MEDIAN gives unique A_EIG and unique A_L1_EVSI minimizers and they differ
property_predicates.B_SEPARABLE: exists policy y->q_y over every nonempty G_y such that m->m[q_y] is injective on each G_y

bank_suite.property_selection: lowest satisfying scan index; report index, canonical bytes, SHA256, and lexically first witness

property_witness_encoding.B_BALANCED_MARGINAL: lowest witnessing y and lexical first unequal ordered-pair-vector pair
property_witness_encoding.B_COLLISION: every legal policy in lexical order with its lexical first (y,m,m_prime,r) witness
property_witness_encoding.B_DECOY: lowest witnessing y followed by the two unique query indices
property_witness_encoding.policy: five-int tuple ordered by y; -1 for empty leaf; lexical order

bank_suite.scope: bounded development suite; not the complete C(125,6)=4690625500 multiset family and not an all-bank or all-grammar theorem

checkpoint.cross_arm_exogenous_identity: for fixed bank and H1 leaf, every arm receives byte-identical prototype_table, source_mappings, initial_token_index, public_history, query_counts, and remaining_budget; full state differs only by frozen arm semantics
checkpoint.same_H1_quantifier: for each fixed registered trajectory arm A: same bank and initial-token outcome implies identical full A H1 input, A pre-query semantic state, and A query
checkpoint.same_H2_quantifier: for each fixed registered trajectory arm A: also same A-selected-query outcome implies identical full A H2 input, A posterior, A decision, and A prediction

claim_ceiling: Docs-only freeze for a future seed/world-free exact active-information algorithmic reference on the preregistered bounded hostile bank suite. Candidate-rule amortized lookup equivalence is expected, so 001D cannot prove learned representation or non-memorization. It is not an all-bank/all-grammar theorem and provides no product, controller, neural, heldout, survival, AGI, agency, consciousness, subjectivity, emotion, companion, or electronic-life evidence.

FINITE_ACTIVE_TRANSFER_STATE_V1.consistency_counts_rule: c_B(pi) times full-history compatibility for every arm, before fallback
FINITE_ACTIVE_TRANSFER_STATE_V1.effective_rule: elementwise sum of sealed_family_contributions; normalize only for decision

decision.lcb05_benefit: same-history scratch token L1 loss minus transfer token L1 loss under each transfer-posterior mapping
decision.lcb05_rule: use transfer iff exact lower-5-percent quantile>=0; otherwise same-history scratch
decision.loss: sum absolute error in signed integer micro-units
median_assertions: lower, serialized midpoint, and upper have equal minimal weighted L1 risk
decision.median_midpoint: Fraction(lower+upper,2), serialized by exact round-half-even to integer

decomposition.common_raw: baseline loss minus candidate loss outside {initial,qC,qB}
decomposition.query_asymmetry_raw: baseline loss at qC minus candidate loss at qB when qC!=qB; else 0

endpoints.member_weighting: distinct exact members equal weight; entry-weighted summaries diagnostic only
endpoints.uniform_mixture: exact expected fixed-branch metrics; no single token set or prediction; cannot rescue

future_runtime_blocker.fact: controller on_committed callback is absent from store recovery recomputation
future_runtime_blocker.forbidden: effectful transfer state mutation in callback or outside canonical reducer state; direct transition_world or selected-action injection
future_runtime_blocker.minimum_future_resolution: callbacks read-only; whitelist-only pending public row in replay-canonical reducer state, adopted after successful commit and consumed on next compute, or separately frozen replay-equivalent rule

gates.active_delete: on B_SEPARABLE a unique candidate query differs from passive and candidate common-unqueried advantage>=4375/1000000 for at least one exact member
gates.attribution_gate: joint_ablation plus replay/leakage prerequisites and no omitted execution
gates.bounded_safety: every D2-D5 primary target full regret vs PUBLIC<=4375/1000000
gates.candidate_selection: sole conservative primary ARM_I_TRANSFER__A_L1_EVSI__D_LCB05_FALLBACK; EIG/passive/fixed cannot rescue
gates.canonical_member: lexicographically smallest distinct source mapping fixed per each of 75 primary roles
gates.control_pareto_match: over every primary target control full MAE<=candidate and over every distinct member control common-unqueried MAE<=candidate, with at least one strict improvement or byte-identical metrics everywhere
gates.explicit_consistency_non_equivalence: candidate common-unqueried advantage>=4375/1000000 on at least one exact member and candidate full MAE no worse by any positive amount on every primary target; otherwise control_match=true
gates.joint_ablation: all causal_effect_predicates, property controls, invariances, replay/leakage prerequisites, amortized-lookup byte equality, and no omitted execution
gates.member_and_forward: every distinct exact member full improvement vs PUBLIC>=21875/1000000 and common/same-history>=0; canonical member common and same-history>=4375/1000000

property_negative_controls.B_BALANCED_MARGINAL: on witness H1 ARM_I_CONSISTENCY__A_EIG__D_L1_MEDIAN has all four eligible tokens as exact minimizers and the I_CONSISTENCY maximum-outcome-entropy alias matches
property_negative_controls.B_COLLISION: emit unavoidable loss-relevant leaf and never report full source-support identification
property_negative_controls.B_DECOY: frozen unique A_EIG and A_L1_EVSI minimizers exist and differ
property_negative_controls.MULT_6: ordinary transfer and multiplicity-flattened transfer have byte-identical semantic state, query score, choice, and prediction

gates.raw_bounded_safety: raw challenger full regret vs PUBLIC<=4375/1000000 on every D2-D5 primary target
gates.source_delete: member-and-forward fails and full benefit of every distinct exact member in every primary role is reduced by >=21875/1000000
gates.strict_safety: every D2-D5 primary target full regret vs PUBLIC<=0

canonical_state_contributions.I_CONSISTENCY: H1 incoming {0,c_B,0}; H2 incoming previous sealed; positive compatible source seals {0,c_B*compat,0}; zero source seals exact full-history scratch {compat,0,0}
canonical_state_contributions.I_NO_UPDATE: incoming and sealed equal unconditioned I_TRANSFER components at both H1 and H2
canonical_state_contributions.I_SCRATCH: {scratch:1,source:0,local:0} with ordinary conditioning; H2 incoming is previous sealed
canonical_state_contributions.I_SHAM: I_TRANSFER rule with sham-rotated source counts
canonical_state_contributions.I_TRANSFER: H1 incoming {1,20*c_B,2*c_L}; ordinary rows multiply components by compatibility; H2 incoming is previous sealed
canonical_state_contributions.I_TRANSFER_MASK_H2: ordinary transfer H1; H2 incoming and sealed both equal sealed H1 contributions
canonical_state_contributions.I_TRANSFER_THEN_SCRATCH: ordinary transfer H1; H2 incoming scratch conditioned on H1 and sealed scratch conditioned on full H2; source/local zero

definitions.I_CONSISTENCY: compatible source entries with multiplicity; exact same-history scratch fallback if empty
definitions.I_NO_UPDATE: unconditioned transfer and scratch priors for unqueried acquisition, prediction, and LCB comparison; rows only receipts and observed copies
definitions.I_SCRATCH: uniform weight 1 over 120 mappings conditioned on every row
definitions.I_SHAM: I_TRANSFER on cyclic source tuple rotation (m1,m2,m3,m4,m0)
definitions.I_TRANSFER: primitive weight 1+20*c_B(pi)+2*c_L(pi), exactly equal thirds scratch/source/60-entry one-transposition local family
definitions.I_TRANSFER_FLAT: k+120*c_U(pi)+12*c_LU(pi) over unique support and its regenerated local neighbours
definitions.I_TRANSFER_MASK_H2: condition H1; serialize/copy H2 observed token but retain H1 transfer and H1 scratch posteriors for unqueried prediction and LCB comparison
definitions.I_TRANSFER_THEN_SCRATCH: choose under transfer H1 then exact scratch on identical H2

inference.likelihood: 1 iff all legal own-history rows agree with mapping; else 0
inference.mdl_use: none; combining an unfrozen code score with normalized finite Bayes would double-count evidence
inference.model_average: canonical sealed scratch/source/local contribution arrays implement BMA; decisions normalize only their elementwise sum; family sums are derived receipts, never a free posterior decomposition
inference.zero_total_evidence: unexpected zero effective mass is ACTIVE_TRANSFER_INSTRUMENT_INVALID; declared I_CONSISTENCY empty-source support first transitions to exact same-history scratch and seals nonzero state

forbidden_classes: world layout policy run source IDs
leakage.positive_controls: inject every forbidden class as extra key and encoded wrong-type/range content; schema plus semantic recomputation must reject

lineage_discontinuity.changed_variable: second public query selected after a byte-identical H1 public leaf

public_grammar.mapping_space: all itertools.permutations(range(5)) in lexicographic order; pi[q] is prototype index

research_question: From an identical H1 public leaf, can source-aware loss-matched active diagnosis produce exact-member genuine-forward gain and bounded or strict D2-D5 safety beyond equal-access public and consistency risk-DP controls on the frozen bounded suite?

trace_replay.arithmetic: unbounded signed integers and exact reduced rationals only

verdict_dispatch.predicate: any forbidden direct/encoded input or leakage positive-control failure
authority, schema, bank, arm, ablation, replay, amortized-lookup mismatch, or recompute failure not assigned a sensitivity verdict
ordinary non-sensitivity verdict differs across lower, midpoint, and upper legal median conventions
ordinary non-sensitivity verdict differs across exact minimizing-query policies
raw_upside and raw challenger fails bounded safety and conservative primary fails bounded_core
raw_upside and raw challenger clears bounded safety and conservative primary fails bounded_core
not raw_upside and conservative primary fails bounded_core
conservative primary clears bounded_core and fails attribution_gate
conservative primary clears bounded_joint and fails strict_core
conservative primary clears strict_joint and has structural control_match=true
conservative primary clears strict_joint with structural control_match=false; amortized lookup equality limits this to algorithmic-reference evidence
